svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A rectangular tube, bore 150 x 170, from four strips of 3 mm PVC

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: glued with PVC cement: two 49 x 156 and two 49 x 170.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 49 is the design-case length: cut it so the collar reaches from

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the hood plate's outside face to the housing's end lining.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Flange: a 3 mm PVC frame 196 x 216 with a 156 x 176 hole, glued

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: round the tube 23 from its outdoor end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Four 5.5 holes in the flange, 6 in from the long edges and 7 in

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: from the short edges (at its corners).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the outdoor end goes through the panel cut-out into the hood

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: back plate; the flange lies on the panel's room face; four M5

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bolts clamp flange, panel and hood plate. The room end slides

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 6 into the housing opening on 2 mm foam gasket.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: bore square; flange flat on the panel.
